about: drawn after the LEAP Hand paper's own photo of the hand (Shaw, Agarwal and Pathak, RSS 2023, figure 1: the hand palm-on in white light, 2026-11-17): a hand black all over but for its four white fingertips (the paper's figure 8, the hand on an xArm, shows a build whose fingertips are printed black: the Library draws the hero photo's white).  The palm is a matte black print with a fine texture; the finger and thumb links, the Dynamixel servos in their black brackets, are one satin black (the photo shows the cases and the brackets alike, #2b2b2e to #333336); the fingertips are white soft prints, a cool matte white (#d7d7dd to #dcdce2 under the flash), no gloss.  Not modelled: the servos' cables and horns, the screws, the print's layer lines.

tip-white.evidence: the paper's figure 1: the four fingertips are one matte white with a cool cast, #d7d7dd in the middle of a lit tip and #dcdce2 at its brightest, a soft shade toward the edges and no highlight: rougher than the base's satin shell

servo-black.evidence: the paper's figure 1: the servo cases and their brackets on every finger, #2b2b2e to #333336 on their lit faces, #151414 in the gaps, with a faint sheen along their edges: a little rougher than the base's moulded satin

palm-black.evidence: the paper's figure 1: the palm is a matte black print, #242425 to #343436 with a fine grain and no highlight anywhere on its broad face
